svg.aria-label: The lit-review mode, detailed view. Boxes: academic-paper 3.2.0: Intake, citation verification: mark only or strict (stop); Literature strategist (agent); You review the sources: add or remove, optional (stop); Annotated bibliography, literature matrix, synthesis (agent) | paper, as built: Intake agent: config.md, citation verification, the number of sources [5.Q item 6], the research question the run needs [AD11, AV15] (stop); Session: one literature strategist, or several with a merge, each start's brief written by the session, the choice in config.md Decisions [Paper's lit-review as academic-paper's] (question); Literature strategists, the starts the session briefs, at once [Paper's lit-review as academic-paper's] (ruled, only when needed); Literature strategist, the merge the session briefs: review.md and refs.bib, with the synthesis analysis [Paper's lit-review as academic-paper's] (ruled, only when needed); Literature strategist: review.md with the synthesis analysis, refs.bib; a list over 50 entries shows its first 20 and last 5; it does not start without a research question [D2, AD11, AV15, AV16] (ruled, only when needed); The strategist, or the merge: review.md and refs.bib written with its own edits, its own query scripts allowed [Paper's lit-review as academic-paper's] (ruled); Session: the report of each start read as it ends (question); Script, run by the session: lookup.py resolve once over every entry of refs.bib; a proceedings page for an entry with neither; checks.md (script); Literature strategist that wrote refs.bib, resumed with checks.md: the differing titles resolved; strict: a failing identifier corrected or removed, once [O] (ruled); Script, run by the session: lookup.py resolve once again over every entry of refs.bib, into checks.md (script); You review the sources: add or remove, optional [J] (stop); Script, run by the session: lookup.py resolve again on each corrected or added entry's DOI or arXiv ID, into checks.md [O] (script); A reference that cannot be confirmed [O] (stop); End (agent); The mode to run, for a plain request that fits two modes (stop).
